description: This file consolidates exports of helper functions, types, and policies related to inbound channel parsing, including debounce handling, envelope formatting, mention gating, location handling, and session context management, specifically for channel-inbound processing in a plugin SDK.

methods.name: createInboundDebouncer
methods.description: Creates a debouncer for inbound messages to prevent processing floods.

methods.name: resolveInboundDebounceMs
methods.description: Resolves the debounce duration for inbound messages.

methods.name: createDirectDmPreCryptoGuardPolicy
methods.description: Creates policy for pre-crypto guard checks on direct messages.

methods.name: dispatchInboundDirectDmWithRuntime
methods.description: Dispatches inbound direct message with runtime context.

methods.name: formatInboundEnvelope
methods.description: Formats an inbound message envelope for processing.

methods.name: formatInboundFromLabel
methods.description: Formats label information for inbound messages.

methods.name: resolveEnvelopeFormatOptions
methods.description: Determines format options for inbound envelopes.

methods.name: buildMentionRegexes
methods.description: Builds regex patterns for mention detection.

methods.name: matchesMentionPatterns
methods.description: Checks if inbound text matches mention patterns.

methods.name: createChannelInboundDebouncer
methods.description: Creates a debouncer specific to channel-inbound processing.

methods.name: shouldDebounceTextInbound
methods.description: Determines if inbound text should be debounced.

methods.name: resolveMentionGating
methods.description: Resolves mention gating logic for inbound texts.

methods.name: resolveMentionGatingWithBypass
methods.description: Resolves mention gating logic with bypass options.

methods.name: logInboundDrop
methods.description: Logs when inbound messages are dropped.

methods.name: resolveInboundSessionEnvelopeContext
methods.description: Resolves session envelope context for inbound messages.
